english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for polite behavior or the quality of being polite.
This is the all-purpose noun for both the quality of being polite and a polite act or courtesy.
Use this when “tact” means ordinary good manners or polite behaviour rather than sensitivity in handling a situation.
Use this specifically for polite or well-mannered behaviour.

examples.english: They treat people with a lot of courtesy.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 doi6 jan4 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6

examples.english: When dealing with people, politeness is the most basic form of respect.
examples.traditional: 同人相處，禮貌係最基本嘅尊重。
examples.jyutping: tung4 jan4 soeng1 cyu2 lai5 maau6 hai6 zeoi3 gei1 bun2 ge3 zyun1 zung6

examples.english: Show tact when eating with other people, and do not keep using your phone.
examples.traditional: 同人食飯時要有禮貌，唔好一路撳電話。
examples.jyutping: tung4 jan4 sik6 faan6 si4 jiu3 jau5 lai5 maau6 m4 hou2 jat1 lou6 gam6 din6 waa2

examples.english: Their manner toward their elders is very respectful.
